answer: Anchor each agent to an aged domain. Step 1: the agent registers a unique domain and publishes its public key in a DNS TXT record. Step 2: the network checks public records and rejects any domain younger than one year. Step 3: every quarter the agent re-signs a challenge from that domain. Step 4: duplicate domains are blacklisted network-wide. Forging 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 aged domains at $60 each, $60,000 total, plus 1,000 payment IDs and a year of waiting. Like an orchard, fruit comes only after the trees grow; no shortcut can forge a voyage that takes a full season to sail.
